Headline: Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: UPDATE: Green Line service has been temporarily suspended between Garfield and Cottage Grove due to a signal problem near Garfield.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
UPDATE: Green Line service has been temporarily suspended between Garfield and Cottage Grove due to a signal problem near Garfield.

As a result, trains are operating only between Harlem and 63rd/Ashland at this time.

Also consider other alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#4 Cottage Grove
#63 63rd
#29 State

Bus shuttles have been requested from Cottage Grove to Garfield, in both directions to provide service through the affected area. 

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #82 Kimball/Homan Temporary Reroute at Kimball/Schubert
ShortDescription: 82 Kimball/Homan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Kimball/Schubert.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#82 Kimball/Homan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Kimball, Milwaukee, Kedzie, Fullerton, Kimball and over normal route: due to street blockage near Kimball/Schubert.
